The company is seeking a Junior Data Entry Operator to input, update, and maintain information in digital databases. This remote role involves transferring data from paper documents into digital spreadsheets, updating customer order statuses, and reviewing entries to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Enter data from paper documents into digital databases and spreadsheets.
Update existing data and figures in digital records.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer order statuses.
Review completed entries and verify information for accuracy.
Identify and correct data entry errors when necessary.
Industries Technology, Information and Internet
